lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Hi,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Wonderful day, isn't it?
Very much so.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Yep, sure is.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: There've been a few accidents here and there,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: but it's been nice and quiet

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: at the Outpost overall.
Couldn't agree more.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Actually, it's a little too peaceful if you ask me.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: As a police officer,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: it's my duty to look after the citizens here.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I feel lucky, but a little worried

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: that I don't have anything to do.
What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Huh?
You're the reason the Outpost is as peaceful as it is.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Hehe, I promise I wasn't fishing for a compliment,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: but thank you for saying that.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Hmm? Wait a minute.
Poli leaves for a while, then comes back.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I'm back. I received a phone call saying that there had been a network issue.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I sent Exia to go solve it.
You all really do work hard.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I wouldn't go that far...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Well, it's about time I go over

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: the complaints we've received from the public.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Oh shoot, I haven't read Miranda's report yet!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Eek!
What would we do without you, Poli?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Haha, you compliment me too much!
Honestly, you've done so much for the Outpost.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Well, I can't deny it.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: After all, the best feeling a police officer can have is when

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: their district is nice and safe.
My thoughts exactly.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: You really make me feel good about myself.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Thank you for that.
Sure, but you never ask how I'm doing...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I know you. You're pulling my leg right now! Way to spoil the mood...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Grrrrr!
Sorry, couldn't resist! Haha

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I gotta go back to work.
Don't work too hard.
